description.value:
An external Linear Frame, Super Luxury at least (price on request). Three Interface Plug installs to connect; 3 Actions on or off. Connected: BODY 14 (no HP or Death Save change), MOVE 6 unless yours is higher, armor and weapon penalties to REF, DEX and MOVE halved (round up), and it works as Jump Boosters, Reinforced Cyberlegs and Skate Feet. With both hands on its controls, two back-mounted arms work as Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mounts, aimed anywhere you can see: weapons in them fire one-handed, count as linked for Smart gear, and can't be shot or knocked loose. Hardened: no EMP, Microwaver or Black ICE effect, and no quickhack or netrunning, touches it. A coded chest release frees an injured pilot. Either arm can carry an Advanced Optical Shield (a 25 HP Bulletproof Shield that counts as two active Chameleon Coatings from the front past 25m) or the frame-only IronWind and EarthBreaker below.

Cost: [REDACTED] (Super Luxury, at minimum)

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods
